source.name: Relic community API (the game's own match service)

rules.rankBandMeaning: Numeric bands of mean matchhistorymember.oldrating across the match. Historical Rank Points and medal divisions are not supplied by this endpoint.
rules.ratingField: average player rating before the match, as Relic recorded it for that ladder
rules.winRate: winning civilization appearances / (winning + losing civilization appearances)
rules.pickRate: civilization appearances / all civilization appearances; does not affect ranking

sampling.method: Deduplicated recent ranked match histories of active leaderboard players rated 1200+; accumulated across collection runs.
sampling.limitations: A leaderboard-seeded sample, not a census or a random sample of all ladder games. Team appearances within a match share an outcome.
